title: What Becomes Visible
ambiguity: workplace and closed institution remain simultaneously plausible
literary_reference: Dostoevsky's Notes from a Dead House is recalled as a conceptual point of departure; the chapter develops an original contemporary question rather than reproducing the source.
central_question: What separates work from punishment when a person can see the result and their own contribution?
transformation: A new system exposes the intended result before execution and records individual contributions without erasing other contributors.

observer_choices.label: Follow the human meaning of work and contribution.
Follow the structure of results, contribution, and accountability.
Follow the unresolved tension between work, punishment, and freedom.
